items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Our friend Larry Cart asked me

ctx.x: Things that sound written are written put it that way. I can’t tell you specifically. I haven’t heard it for a long time but I think it’s really beautiful.

Our friend Larry Cart asked me, I told him I was going to be seeing you, he said: “Ask Lee about Billy Bauer” because you and Billy seemed to have a special relationship where no matter what the setting you were in, either duo or with a
rhythm section, there was just something about Billy’s comping that seemed to inspire you.
